title: Launch vanguard cohort and postmortem readiness runbook for multi-surface release
creator: Priya Patel
description: Create an actionable runbook and orchestration plan for a small vanguard cohort (2% traffic) that validates runtime, console, and API changes in a staggered release train. This ticket covers: 1) definition of vanguard cohorts and selection criteria across regions; 2) pre-launch checks, telemetry thresholds, and automated halt conditions; 3) communication and escalation matrices for SRE/Platform/PM/Design; 4) postmortem readiness checklist and triage playbook; 5) a lightweight rehearsal schedule and ownership roster for the week-of-go activities. Goal: enable safe validation of model-serving and console changes while minimizing blast radius and ensuring we can produce a targeted postmortem within 48 hours if issues arise.
acceptance_criteria: Runbook doc published in Confluence with step-by-step launch checklist
Telemetry dashboard (latency, error-rate, cost-per-token, tail-latency) linked and validated with alert thresholds
Communication roster and pager/escalation flow agreed and signed off by SRE and Platform leads
Automated canary halt policy implemented in routing layer with documented rollback trigger conditions
Two rehearsals executed with stakeholders and rehearsal notes captured
